units: Targ. Ex. V, 8 (O. ed. Berl. Pa.); a. fr.—
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Taanit 4:2:9">Y. Taan. IV, 68ᵃ</cite> [read:] <he>בגין דצָוְוחִין עלויי ציפוראיי</he> because the people of Sepphoris cry out against him (dislike him).
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 6a:11">B. Mets. 6ᵃ</cite> <he>דקא צ׳</he> when he cried (complained of being wronged).
<cite ref="Sukkah 31a:8">Succ. 31ᵃ</cite> <he>צָוְוחָה ולא אשגח וכ׳</he> (h. form) she complained, but R. N. did not mind her.
<cite ref="Sukkah 31a:8">Ib.</cite> <he>איתתא … צָוְוחָא קמייכו</he> a woman whose father kept three hundred and eighteen servants is complaining before you.
B. Kam. 86ᵃ וצ׳ מהנהו קרטופני Ms. M. (v. Pa.) and he cries (feels pain) on account of the sores; a. fr.
<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 28:2">Lev. R. s. 28</cite> … <he>מאן דלא צַוְוחִינָן ליה וכ׳</he> who is he whom we did not invite, and who wrote these words?; a. e.
<cite ref="Targum of I Chronicles 2:55">Targ. I Chr. II, 55</cite>; a. fr.—

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shabbat 9:1:3">Y. Sabb. IX, 11ᵈ</cite>; <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 39">Gen. R. s. 39</cite>, end, a. e. <he>תמן צָוְוחִין וכ׳</he>, v. <cite ref="P00885"><he>עֲמֵילָא</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 87">Gen. R. s. 87</cite>, beg., v. <cite ref="Q02155"><he>פַּתְיָא</he> I</cite>; a. fr.—[<cite ref="Pesachim 110b:6">Pes. 110ᵇ</cite> <he>צווח דיקלא</he>, v. <cite ref="R00188"><he>צְוֵי</he> II</cite>.]
<cite ref="Onkelos Exodus 5:8">Targ. O. Ex. V, 8</cite>, v. supra.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on II Kings 2:12">Targ. II Kings II, 12</cite>; a. fr.

<cite ref="Shabbat 33b">Sabb. 33ᵇ</cite> <he>וקא נתרן … וקא מְצַוְּוחָן ליה</he> (Ms. M. <he>מצערין</he>) the tears fell (upon his sore body) and gave him pain. B. Kam. l. c. <he>וצַוְּוחי ליה</he> (<he>הנהו וכ׳</he>) Ar. (Rashi <he>מְצַוְּוחֵי</he>; ed. <he>וצווחי מהנהו וכ׳</he>, read <he>וצווח</he>, v. supra) and these sores gave him pain.

senses.gloss: to cause to cry out, excite to discontent.
units: <cite ref="Eruvin 60a:7">Erub. 60ᵃ</cite> <he>חזי דלא מַצְוַוחַת עלה בבי מדרשא</he> (Ms. M. <cite ref="P00790"><he>עלי</he></cite>) see to it that thou do not create discontent with it (me) at college; <cite ref="Avodah Zarah 74b">Ab. Zar. 74ᵇ</cite>
